messages:
Marta: FYI - EU-west kernel hotpatch planned tonight 23:00-00:30 UTC. We'll do a staggered reboot across 5 cohorts (~6 racks) to pick up security fixes. Expected hosted capacity reduction ~15% during peak of rollout. Dedicated pools: we'll cordon but NOT evict unless host fails health checks. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eu-kernel-hotpatch. Please ack and surface any hard constraints.

oncall-sre: Acked. Which cohorts first?

Marta: Order: cohort-3 (low-traffic), cohort-1, cohort-4, cohort-2, cohort-5. Each cohort reboot window ~6-8min with 10m gap. We'll run canary in cohort-3 with 2 racks first.

Devops: Question - any special network steps? We had flaps last time when BGP adj restarted.

Marta: Good call. Network team will drain control-plane sessions prior to host reboot. We'll also run `bgp-hold 120` and verify LLDP on top-of-rack switches. infra-bot will run preflight.

Jia: I manage a dedicated capacity customer with strict uptime SLA. Can we tag their hosts as "no-evict"?

Marta: Yes @jia - we've added kube annotation `redwood/evict-policy=hold` for those hosts. If a host fails health, oncall must approve manual eviction.

Tom: Cost note - cross-region fallback into EU-other will spike egress and token ops. Finance asked for estimate.

Finance-bot: Preliminary cost delta estimate: +6-9% token spend for the window given fallback route and KV cache misses. Detailed calc sent to #finance.

Marta: If we exceed +10% we throttle noncritical embedding writes and pause nightly eval runs. Please disable heavy batch jobs 30m before window.

Deploy-bot: Canary deployment gate opened. Canary id c-eu-2026-3619.

oncall-sre: What are rollback triggers? p95 latency > 700ms? request error-rate?

Marta: Rollback if any: p95 > 500ms sustained 5m, controlplane error rate >1% sustained 3m, kernel oops detected on >2 hosts in a cohort. Rollback steps = stop reboots, revert any traffic shifts, mark cohort as quarantined, escalate to kernel team.

Devops: I'll run the bgp preflight script now: `./ops/bgp_preflight.sh eu-west -d`

infra-bot: Preflight results: disk-health OK, BGP preflight OK, kv-cache hitrate baseline 78%.

Jia: Acknowledged. I'll notify my customer and confirm manual eviction approval flow.

Marta: Final reminder 45m before. Thanks everyone. We'll post live updates in this thread during the window.
